notes:
- Prospect: national coastal infrastructure operator with on-site command centers; heavy operational continuity constraints.
- Primary ask: fully air-gapped Private deployment in their two data centers; no outbound connectivity to public model repos.
- Models: prefer open checkpoints (Llama-family variants) with our verification, but will accept Redwood-verified artifacts delivered via signed offline bundles.
- Latency/throughput: sub-150ms token latency for assistants in control-room workflows; bursty throughput during incidents (200 concurrent flows).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to pay for predictable reserved capacity + prioritized support.
- Security: "No cloud egress allowed for inference or KV caches." Copied from CTO on call. Require HSM-backed key storage, SSO/SAML from enterprise IdP, audit log retention 7+ years.
- POC ask: 6-week on-prem POC (private control plane in customer network, RW-managed appliance nodes), smoke tests: model load, offline model update, disaster failover to separate datacenter.
- Quote feedback: wants explicit MTTI and on-call escalation SLAs for incident windows.
- Internal notes: facilities needs confirmation of rack power (12kW per rack) and secure courier path for signed model bundles.
- Quote decision expected post internal security board meeting (target: 2026-03).
